title: Count Number of Maximum Bitwise-OR Subsets
goal: Count nonempty subsets achieving the maximum possible bitwise OR.
strategy: The OR of all values is the target. A frequency DP maps each attainable OR to the number of subsets producing it; each new value may be skipped or included.
